tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The BDCOM S5610-2AC is a powerful Layer 2/Layer 3 Lite Managed Switch designed to deliver high-speed connectivity and reliable network performance for enterprise, ISP, campus, and data center environments. Equipped with 2×10G SFP+ fiber uplink ports and 2×10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit RJ45 ports, it provides a flexible solution for high-bandwidth backbone and aggregation networks.


Built with advanced Layer 2 and Layer 3 Lite switching capabilities, the BDCOM S5610-2AC supports VLAN, QoS, Static Routing, IPv4/IPv6, Link Aggregation (LACP), ACL, IGMP Snooping, and comprehensive network management features. These capabilities ensure secure, efficient, and scalable networking while minimizing downtime and maximizing throughput.


Whether you're expanding an ISP infrastructure, upgrading a business network, or building a reliable fiber backbone, the BDCOM S5610-2AC offers enterprise-grade performance with easy deployment and centralized management.


Key Features

  • 2 × 10G SFP+ fiber uplink ports
  • 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit RJ45 Ethernet ports
  • Layer 2 & Layer 3 Lite managed switching
  • High-speed 10G fiber backbone connectivity
  • Supports Static Routing for efficient traffic forwarding
  • IEEE 802.1Q VLAN and QinQ support
  • Quality of Service (QoS) traffic prioritization
  • Link Aggregation (LACP) for increased bandwidth
  • IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack support
  • Access Control List (ACL) for enhanced security
  • IGMP Snooping for multicast optimization
  • STP, RSTP, and MSTP loop prevention
  • Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, Telnet, and SSH management
  • Rack-mountable enterprise design
  • Energy-efficient and stable operation
